risk_formula_note: Weighted 0-100 score. Components (weight): unpaired_allocations (0.20), manual_allocations (0.15), raw_pointer_count (0.18), pointer_arithmetic (0.12), void_pointers (0.08), cyclomatic (0.15), goto_count (0.05), legacy_crypto (0.04), precision_loss (0.03). Each component saturates as 100*(1-exp(-v/scale)). Identical formula must be used for the after-run - xem RISK_WEIGHTS trong demo/measure.py.
selection_criteria: Kich thuoc vua du de IBM Bob modernize tron ven trong 48h (< ~1500 LOC/file)
malloc/calloc/realloc/free duoc goi TRUC TIEP, khong bi boc sau macro - de delta before/after do duoc chinh xac

reasons: Risk score cao nhat trong nhom co kich thuoc kha thi cho 48h (48.69): 444 raw pointer tren 1342 LOC, cyclomatic 325.
Vong doi bo nho thu cong rat phan tan: 10 alloc nhung 49 free nam rai rac o nhieu nhanh cleanup khac nhau - dung mau loi 'free duong dan loi' kinh dien.
59 lenh goto tao thang error-handling; day chinh la thu Bob co the thay bang RAII/cleanup-function attribute, cho delta cyclomatic + goto rat de show tren slide.
Mat do con tro tho cao nhat toan dataset: 314 raw pointer / 360 LOC (~0.87 con tro moi dong code).
Cap phat ma tran 2 chieu thu cong bang double** - malloc long nhau theo vong lap, va 42 loi goi free trong cac vong cleanup long nhau; chi can sot 1 nhanh la leak.
74 phep pointer arithmetic de index ma tran: Bob thay bang index 2D an toan se lam raw_pointer_count + pointer_arithmetic giam manh, rat truc quan cho bieu do.
File DUY NHAT trong nhom co so alloc > so free o muc file (12 alloc vs 11 free) - tuc la co mot duong cap phat khong co doi free tuong ung, bang chung leak manh nhat de ke chuyen.
Xu ly buffer cap thap voi void* va 22 phep pointer arithmetic, cong them fd/process handling - dung kieu code ma memory-safety rewrite co gia tri that.
Chi 313 LOC / 10 ham nen Bob co the viet lai tron ven va van con thoi gian verify trong window 48h.
Vong doi bo nho thu cong kem doc lenh: 5 alloc / 21 free tren 569 LOC, bo nho duoc cap o ham nay nhung giai phong o ham khac.
134 raw pointer + 7 goto trong logic parse/configure - chuoi C string thao tac tho, de tran bo dem.
Cung module clib voi rank 1 (clib-package.c): modernize ca hai cho phep demo 'Bob hieu ca module' thay vi tung file roi le.
Mat do cap phat cao nhat theo LOC: 14 malloc trong chi 247 LOC / 4 ham - toan bo la workspace array cap phat thu cong cho lop C bao quanh Fortran (LAPACK/pfapack).
66 raw pointer duoc truyen thang xuong Fortran, khong co kiem tra bien nao - loi kinh dien cua interop C/Fortran legacy.
Nho va tu chua, nen day la 'clean win' de doan: Bob gan nhu chac chan rewrite thanh cong, dam bao demo co it nhat vai file xanh.
Gan nhu song sinh voi skpfa.c (14 alloc / 18 free, 4 ham, 251 LOC) nhung khac phan xu ly mu 10 - tot de chung minh Bob ap dung BIEN DOI NHAT QUAN tren cac file anh em.
62 raw pointer cho workspace array cap phat/giai phong thu cong trong moi nhanh loi.
Neu skpfa.c va skpf10.c cho cung mot % giam, do la bang chung transformation on dinh chu khong phai may man.
File nho nhat trong bo (217 LOC) voi 12 alloc / 12 free can bang o muc dem - dung lam SMOKE TEST cho Bob truoc khi chay cac file lon.
60 raw pointer cho matrix transform workspace; tuy can bang ve so dem, cac free nam trong nhanh loi rieng nen van co kha nang leak that.
Thoi gian modernize ngan nhat, nen day la file nen chay dau tien trong window 48h de validate pipeline before/after.

excluded_candidates.exclusion_reason: Risk score cao nhat toan dataset nhung 9877 LOC / 585 ham trong MOT header - khong kha thi de Bob modernize tron ven trong 48h, va neu chi lam mot phan thi so lieu before/after se khong so sanh duoc. Co the dung lam 'stretch goal' neu con thoi gian.
5833 LOC qua lon cho window 48h. Quan trong hon: moi cap phat di qua macro STBI_MALLOC/STBI_FREE nen measure.py dem alloc_count = 0 va free_count = 0 - cot malloc/free trong bang so sanh se vo nghia.

Kich thuoc thi kha thi (875 LOC) nhung toan bo cap phat di qua macro s_malloc/s_realloc/s_free, nen measure.py bao cao alloc = free = 0. Delta malloc/free se khong do duoc. Neu muon dung file nay, phai mo rong analyzer/memory.py de nhan dien allocator wrapper truoc.

known_measurement_gap: analyzer/memory.py chi dem loi goi TRUC TIEP malloc/calloc/realloc/free. Cac file boc allocator sau macro (STBI_MALLOC, s_malloc, ...) se bao cao alloc/free = 0. Tat ca 7 file da chon deu goi truc tiep nen khong bi anh huong.
